component.name: GMK104 Studio
component.summary: Edit the screen and keymap of a ZUOYA GMK104 keyboard on Linux

description.p: A native Linux keyboard screen editor with black transparency, proportional fitting, animation previews, local upload history, and settings backups.
Edit four keymap layers with a physical keyboard preview, searchable key picker, staged change review, private backups, verified writes, and restoration from saved defaults or keymap backups.
This independent reverse-engineered utility is not affiliated with the keyboard manufacturer. Use at your own risk; device damage is possible.
